changeSet.sql: ALTER TRIGGER ArtifactType_AfterUpdate ON ArtifactType AFTER UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON update T set T.Name = S.Name, T.Description = S.Description, T.CanOwnFusion= S.CanOwnFusion, T.DisplayFormat = S.DisplayFormat, T.UpdatedBy = S.UpdatedBy, T.UpdatedOn = S.UpdatedOn from AssetType T inner join inserted S on T.Object = 'ArtifactType' and T.ObjectID = S.ID
